memoryQueries.sql: SELECT data FROM state WHERE key = ?

WITH owners AS (
      SELECT id,data FROM memories WHERE json_extract(data,'$.status') NOT IN ('merged','discarded') AND
      ((json_extract(data,'$.kind')='short' AND json_extract(data,'$.capacityExitedAt') IS NULL AND (? OR julianday(json_extract(data,'$.shortExpiresAt'))>julianday(?))) OR
       (json_extract(data,'$.kind')='long' AND json_extract(data,'$.status')!='durable' AND julianday(json_extract(data,'$.retainedFrom'))<=julianday(?) AND (? OR (CASE WHEN json_extract(data,'$.kind')='long' AND json_extract(data,'$.status')='active' AND json_extract(data,'$.mergedInto') IS NULL THEN COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.archiveEnteredAt'),json_extract(data,'$.capacityExitedAt'),CASE WHEN julianday(json_extract(data,'$.expiresAt'))<=julianday(?) THEN json_extract(data,'$.expiresAt') END) END) IS NULL)))
      UNION ALL SELECT id,data FROM details
      UNION ALL SELECT id,data FROM learned_background WHERE json_extract(data,'$.status')='active')
      SELECT o.data,i.vector FROM owners o LEFT JOIN memory_index i ON i.ownerType=json_extract(o.data,'$.ownerType') AND i.ownerId=o.id AND i.revision=json_extract(o.data,'$.revision') AND i.configSignature=?

recentQueries.sql:
WITH ranks AS (
 SELECT MAX(json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId')) AS id,MAX(hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(data,'$.receivedAt'))) AS rank,MAX(hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(data,'$.receivedAt')) IS NULL) AS invalidTime FROM messages WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.sharedActivityId'),'')='' AND COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId'),'')!='' AND (json_extract(data,'$.direction')='outgoing' OR COALESCE(json_type(data,'$.seenTurnId'),'missing')!='null') GROUP BY json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId')
 
 ),combined AS (SELECT id,MAX(rank) AS rank,MAX(invalidTime) AS invalidTime FROM ranks GROUP BY id),
 joined AS (SELECT c.id,c.rank,hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(e.data,'$.openedAt')) AS openedEpoch,c.invalidTime OR hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(e.data,'$.openedAt')) IS NULL AS invalidTime FROM combined c JOIN chat_episodes e ON e.id=c.id),
 ranked AS (SELECT *,MAX(invalidTime) OVER () AS anyInvalidTime,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rank DESC,openedEpoch DESC) AS boundary FROM joined)
 SELECT id,rank,openedEpoch,anyInvalidTime AS invalidTime FROM ranked WHERE boundary<=?
